kim (CEO): Quick leadership snapshot for the week — EU Private beta is go for a limited cohort next week. Two top asks: finalize retention defaults and stabilize p95 for Dedicated EU. Need short slide bullets by Thu COB.

sanya_vp_ops: Ops running a final cert rotation check tonight. Will also schedule a small canary for retention flags in eu-west-1 (0.25% traffic).

lee_eng: Perf team will produce p95/p99 matrix by region+model. Also adding an alert for KV cache-miss spikes post-retention-change.

taylor_fin: Finance is tracking a -6% unit cost target next quarter. Short levers: quantization on non-critical models + reserved pool tuning. Sharing sims after lunch.

ops-bot: System notice: "Retention flag planned: retention.default_days_private=30; canary_window=0.25% eu-west-1" React with :eyes: to acknowledge.

ravi_cs: CS note: two pilot customers asked for extended retention for audits. Legal okayed contract exceptions; will prepare comms template.

kim (CEO): Owners: Sanya (canary + cert check), Lee (SLA numbers), Taylor (cost slide), Ravi/Maya (customer comms). If any metric shows >1% customer impact during canary, pause rollout and escalate to me.

end of thread
